description: Move a pickup order on the pickup monitor board, as dragging its card does. move: picked; ready (ready for pickup: texts or emails the customer the ready notification unless notifyCustomer=false; optional pickupPosition); picked_up (from Ready: completes the order, sends the picked-up notification unless notifyCustomer=false, and marks the Shopify order fulfilled); fulfilled (completes from any open stage without messaging the customer, like Mark as Fulfilled); back_to_picked; back_to_new; hold (puts it On Hold); release (takes it off hold); reschedule (scheduledPickupAt, ISO 8601 — without an offset it is store-local time; never messages the customer). The preview shows the exact message the customer would get, or why none goes out. Requires Write + pickup.execute; operator credentials only. Preview first, then repeat identical arguments with previewReceipt and idempotencyKey. In-app assistants get a confirm card.

move.description: picked, ready, picked_up, fulfilled, back_to_picked, back_to_new, hold, release or reschedule.

notifyCustomer.description: ready and picked_up: false skips the customer notification (default true).

order.description: Pickup order id, order number or pickup code.

pickupPosition.description: ready, picked_up or fulfilled: the pickup position (name or id from get_pickup_settings) the order is staged at.

scheduledPickupAt.description: reschedule: the new pickup time, ISO 8601 (e.g. 2026-10-07T15:30). Without an offset it is the store's local time.

name: move_pickup_order
title: Move Pickup Order
